purpose: Make Mechanicus current truth and receipt state machine-readable, bounded and auditable without claiming full organ assembly.
rules: Current truth must be declared in a machine-readable index, not reconstructed from chat memory.
Every current gate state used for Mechanicus readiness must point to a generated report and receipt when the gate has a patch-level receipt.
Generated current-truth reports must parse as JSON and must be paired with a human-readable MD report.
Historical, superseded or negative-example artifacts may remain in the repo but must not be promoted to current truth unless explicitly listed in the current truth index.
G5 may set current truth / receipts to PASS_BASELINE only; it may not set G6 residency/trust, Custodes prosecution or Throne crown status to PASS.
Local model membrane remains DEFERRED_AFTER_CORE_V1 and cannot be a source of current truth.
pass_meaning: Mechanicus has a baseline current-truth/receipt index for its self-closure gates and all indexed current truth evidence exists, parses and avoids overclaim.
pass_does_not_mean: All old reports are superseded or cleaned
